validation_map.center: x_bar=(U_bar,V_bar,N_bar) produced in the future by the frozen corrected-grid Newton chronology from the authenticated analytic seed
validation_map.approximate_derivative: A_dagger, a future interval-free finite operator plus analytically bounded tail action encoded under the corrected state/grid ABI
validation_map.approximate_inverse: A, a future bounded linear bijection from residual space to state space, represented by a directed-ball finite operator plus analytically bounded tail action under the corrected state/grid ABI

bounds.Y: an outward upper bound on norm(A*F(x_bar))
bounds.Z0: an outward upper bound on norm(I-A*A_dagger)
bounds.Z1: an outward upper bound on norm(A*(DF(x_bar)-A_dagger))
bounds.Z2: an outward upper bound satisfying norm(A*(DF(x)-DF(x_bar)))<=Z2*norm(x-x_bar) for every x in the largest preregistered ball

candidate_radii.selection: the least-index r_j satisfying every strict predicate; if none passes, endpoint validation FAILS

strict_pass_predicates: Y>=0, Z0>=0, Z1>=0, Z2>=0 are finite outward enclosures
the entire ball satisfies every admissible_ball_condition
validation_map.touching_or_unknown_rule: an interval touching a strict boundary, a missing bound, invalid arithmetic or an undecidable comparison is FAIL
validation_map.result_if_passed: one and only one zero of F exists in the selected closed ball; the bordered derivative is invertible throughout that ball

proof_record_abi.wire_codec: the separately versioned S4-R1 wire/record contract; no native float, NaN or infinity permitted
